title: Sources and Method
intro: Focus Camp is a self-help programme based on research into problematic pornography use and compulsive sexual behaviour. It doesn't diagnose and doesn't replace treatment.
method: Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT): choosing behaviour by your values instead of fighting the urge.
Cognitive behavioural approach (CBT): noticing the chain of trigger, thought, feeling and behaviour.
Self-monitoring, shaping your environment and If–Then plans.
Relapse prevention: meeting a slip with learning rather than shame.
A 6-week core programme with consolidation up to day 90.
reviewNote: All content will be reviewed by a clinical psychologist or psychiatrist before publication. Until the review is complete, content is marked “not reviewed”.
